New 'Ghost in the Shell' TV Anime Announces Supporting Cast Pair
The official website for the new Koukaku Kidoutai (The Ghost in the Shell) television anime announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The new TV anime premiered on July 7 at 11:00 p.m. on Kansai TV and Fuji TV affiliates. Voice actors Kikuko Inoue (Ghost Concert: Missing Songs) and Shigeru Chiba (Dorohedoro) are joining the cast as Puppet Master (Project 2501) and Nakamura, respectively.
